title: The Church at Auvers, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description Wonderful gift for painting lovers Design inspired by the picture frame Fulfillment of a dream of unique art collection Pure silver and modern decoration techniques Created by Vincent van Gogh in June 1890, shortly before the artist’s death. This and other works of the same type illustrate Van Gogh’s artistic influence on Expressionist painters: the distortion of reality is evident here, and it is easy to see that abandonment of perspective that characterized Expressionist works. This silver coin with miniature reproduction is in the style of the original painting and will make an excellent addition to your home collection!
